about.mission: We make the built world easier to navigate. From road signs to storefronts, TSR has spent 25 years turning precise concepts into clear, lasting visual systems across Kosovo.
story: We work with institutions, businesses, and private projects.
Our approach is minimal, functional, and long-term.
From concept to final installation, everything comes from one team.

values.title: Precision
values.description: Every measurement, cut, and placement held to tight tolerances — from design file to installed sign.

values.title: Safety
values.description: We follow road and construction codes so signs protect and direct in equal measure.

values.title: Durability
values.description: Materials chosen for years of reliable service, tested before they leave the workshop.

values.title: Clarity
values.description: Straightforward communication from quote to handover — no surprises, no subcontractors.

process.title: Design
process.description: Site visit, technical brief, documented concept. Every project is planned before a single cut is made.

process.title: Production
process.description: In-house manufacturing with reflective films, aluminum composites, and structural steel.

process.title: Installation
process.description: Our team handles on-site placement, alignment, and final documentation. No subcontractors.

hero.title: Our services
hero.description: Complete solutions from concept to field delivery.

iso.label: Quality Certified
iso.title: Committed to quality at every stage.
iso.body: TSR operates under an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system. From initial design through production and on-site installation, every process is documented, audited, and held to international standards — ensuring consistent results and long-term reliability.
